mode: enrichment (identity evidence only — no auto-merge, no citation-impact fields)

input.possible_duplicates_note: possible_duplicates_commit is the commit that published v0.1's possible-duplicates.csv; that file has not changed since, verified via `git log` on the path before this run.

external_data_source: OpenAlex API — GET /sources/issn:{issn} (singleton lookup, not search)
reproducibility: generator_commit is checkout-able against posi-engine; re-running scripts/enrich-openalex.mjs against the same entities/possible-duplicates input and a warm cache should reproduce identical status/rescoring classifications. Raw per-ISSN OpenAlex responses are not republished here (cache is local-only) — re-running against a cold cache queries OpenAlex live and could reflect upstream data drift since generated_at.

assets.description: Per-candidate enrichment result: status classification, matched OpenAlex source(s), matched ISSNs. One row per v0.1 candidate entity.
